text:
Rae (CSM): @Ned quick pulse: onboarding looks healthy but we noticed an uptick in p95 during peak billing runs. Renewal touches in 5 weeks  want to proactively recommend optimizations. Any constraints around model swaps, quant builds, or routing changes?

Ned (MeridianPay): Were on Dedicated in eu-north; compliance needs model hashes for any new binaries. Peak window is 08:30-10:00 CET. Primary workload is short billing confirmations (~58%) and medium-length receipts (~30%). Cant change throughput reservation until renewal, but can accept routing/quant canaries.

Omar (Solutions Eng): Good options without changing capacity: 1) route short confirmations to a q4 quantized lite model; 2) enable selective KV prefix caching for receipt templates; 3) tighten batching params for medium gens to reduce tail. Example route rules we can stage:```yaml
routes:
  - match: {intent: "billing_confirm", tokens: "<120"}
    target: redwood/assistant-lite-1.3b-q4
  - match: {intent: "receipt_summary", tokens: "120-600"}
    target: redwood/assistant-medium-4b
inference:
  batching:
    max_batch_latency_ms: 10
cache:
  prefix_kv: {enabled: true, ttl_seconds: 3600}
```

Liu (Product): Recommend a cautious canary flow: start 1% -> 5% over 3h. Monitors: p95 latency, error_rate, and a quality checklist (5 golden confirmations + 20 receipts). Auto-rollback if any checklist item fails or p95 increases >18%. Capture token savings estimate for renewal packet.

Ned (MeridianPay): 1%->5% fine. Compliance will need the checksum and a short integrity report. Also ask to avoid canary during our nightly settlement at 22:00 CET.

Omar (Solutions Eng): We'll produce a vetted q4-lite binary for your Dedicated instance and a canary config. Canary snippet:```json
{
  "canary": {"start_pct": 1, "ramp_to_pct": 5, "ramp_hours": 3},
  "monitors": ["p95","error_rate","quality_checklist"],
  "auto_rollback": {"p95_increase_pct": 18, "failed_checks": 1}
}
```

ops-bot: Heads-up: scheduled infra maintenance in eu-north at 1999020000. Rollouts paused during the window.

Rae (CSM): Action items: Omar to build q4-lite and provide checksum; Liu to add golden prompts and set up quality probes; Ned to confirm compliance timebox; Ill schedule a 30-min enablement call next Wed 09:00 CET.

Ned (MeridianPay): We'll get compliance sign-off in ~48h. For renewal notes: if we can hit p95 reduction ~15-20% during peak and token reduction ~12-18% without quality loss, that improves our expansion likelihood.

Liu (Product): Noted. We'll include an A/B probe for user-visible phrasing and average token usage. Please share the 5 confirmation examples and 20 receipts by EOD tomorrow.

Omar (Solutions Eng): Playbook commands for quick rollback: `redwood rollback --deployment meridianpay-dedicated --route billing_confirm` and abort canary `redwood canary abort --id meridian-billing-q4`. I'll also prepare a short pre-read for the enablement call.

Rae (CSM): Thanks team. Captured as renewal briefing goal: lower p95 by 15-20% at peak, decrease average tokens for short confirms by ~15%, and no visible quality regressions. I'll attach results to the renewal packet after the canary. :calendar:
